author: NASS
description:
Travel back to 1940s Quebec, Canada, and discover the winter streets of Trois-Rivières through rare historical footage restored in stunning 4K 60fps. Covered in snow and ice, the massive steel bridge, passing vehicles, and winter streets offer a fascinating glimpse into everyday Canadian life during the 1940s. Using my latest AI restoration and semantic colorization techniques


📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to 4K
• Manual color corrections 
• Classical restoration workflows (AviSynth ) combined with modern tools for (60fps, stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring )
• Sound design created for immersive atmosphere

B&W Video Source from: Library and Archives Canada. Associated Screen News Limited fonds, 1973-0127, IDC 5056
title: Quebec, Canada 1940s - Trois-Rivières | Advanced Colorization & 4K60fps Restoration
